title: Gratin Corn Casserole
description: A delicious and comforting casserole that combines the flavors of corn and creamy sauce. This dish is perfect for a weeknight dinner or a special occasion.
instructions: In a large skillet, heat the olive oil over medium heat. Add the corn kernels and cook until they start to brown, about 5 minutes.
In a separate saucepan, combine the heavy cream and grated cheddar cheese. Heat over low heat, stirring constantly, until the cheese is melted and the sauce is smooth.
Add the cooked corn to the cheese sauce and stir to combine.
Transfer the corn mixture to a 9x13 inch baking dish and smooth the top.
Bake for 25-30 minutes, or until the top is golden brown and the casserole is heated through.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped fresh herbs if desired.
